//: Same PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks as demo/settings.hooks.json, but usable from a working directory OUTSIDE this repo -- see scripts/ask.sh's --demo-db mode. Why this exists: Claude Code walks up parent directories looking for CLAUDE.md (confirmed live -- it loads even when the session starts in demo/, a subdirectory of this repo), so the only way to keep this repo's own CLAUDE.md (which describes this very PII-blocking design) out of a demo-db test session's context is to run it from a directory with no repo ancestry at all. That in turn means the hook commands below cannot rely on a relative cwd to find the vault or the venv -- they `cd` into $VEIL_REPO_ROOT (set by the launching script) first. Relative paths inside pre_tool_use.py/post_tool_use.py themselves (core/hooks/_paths.py's VAULT_DB_PATH) are unchanged; only the shell command wrapping them changes.
